title: Sources: ex-Nvidia executive Jay Puri, who oversaw clients like Alice Huang, controlled chip sales to Supermicro; Puri is married to an ex-Supermicro executive (The Information)
summary: The Information: Sources: ex-Nvidia executive Jay Puri, who oversaw clients like Alice Huang, controlled chip sales to Supermicro; Puri is married to an ex-Supermicro executive — For years, anytime a major Nvidia customer wanted to buy chips or otherwise needed attention, they could turn to the company's longtime former sales chief Jay Puri.
